content.title: Sarah Paulson on Instagram: "My best friend, Amanda Peet—the weirdest thing in the world is to say her full name out loud, as I call her Bird—but that’s the name her parents gave her. Seems fitting to use here as she has written the most profoundly gorgeous essay about the loss of her parents, while dealing with a breast cancer diagnosis. @newyorkermag has published it today, and I’m screaming from the rooftops with joy. I hope you all take the time to read it. If you are running around and doing other stuff, I did the audio recording and you can listen to me try to do the piece justice. My friend is a @newyorkermag essayist. How outrageously groovy is that? Bird, I love you beyond. Link in my bio"
content.text: My best friend, Amanda Peet—the weirdest thing in the world is to say her full name out loud, as I call her Bird—but that’s the name her parents gave her. Seems fitting to use here as she has written the most profoundly gorgeous essay about the loss of her parents, while dealing with a breast cancer diagnosis. @newyorkermag has published it today, and I’m screaming from the rooftops with joy. I hope you all take the time to read it. If you are running around and doing other stuff, I did the audio recording and you can listen to me try to do the piece justice. My friend is a @newyorkermag essayist. How outrageously groovy is that? Bird, I love you beyond. Link in my bioMade me cry and call my momThank you for sharing this. Amanda, bird, was one of my best friends growing up. We went to Friends Seminary together until I left for high school and then we miraculously landed at Columbia University. I remember her parents like it was yesterday as we walked home each day from school to Gramercy Park. Her beautiful, authentic and loving heart poured out on these pages. My heart aching for her and her sister. Give her a huge hug for me. She is remarkable ❤️🙏🏻We wish this wasn't behind a pay wall. Such important contentWould love to read this as I'm a two time survivor. But unfortunately it's behind a paywall. I don't think there's any other way but if some one knows a way other than subscribing please let me know. Thank you.It was beautifully done and such a brave move . You ladies have been friends for as long as I can remember — what a special duo you are . It’s not easy to share such personal stories. Bravo bravo !I read this morning . So extraordinary 🙏🏼🩵Was honored to be trusted with this one. Really specialIt’s such a lovely thing when you pick some celebrities that you like — well, as much as a person can “like” a total stranger — because they feel like really decent people that you could imagine to get to genuinely like if life guided them your way — and then it turns out two of your favourites are best friends ❤️ It shows that their public persona must be quite congruent with their real one. Happy friendship to you, Sarah and Amanda! 👯‍♀️Pal!!! I READ the essay. Like a nerd! I didn’t listen! Now I must!! Man, how incredible is she?!!!!♥️It’s beautiful. She’s beautiful. 🙌I’m a cancer scientist while simultaneously caretaking for my mom who is dying of stage IV cancer. This essay changed my perspective. I can’t thank you enough.
